narrative.intro: Southwest Valley Constructors has $2.3B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Southwest Valley Constructors won 5 awards this fiscal year so far. Southwest Valley Constructors shows an average award size of $451M. Southwest Valley Constructors recorded prior-year activity that is smaller than the FY2026 total: FY21 $78.4M and FY26 $2.3B. Southwest Valley Constructors receives most of its FY2026 obligations from the Department of Homeland Security at $2.2B. Southwest Valley Constructors also has obligations from the Department of Defense at $10.6M. Southwest Valley Constructors sells primarily construction services, with activity concentrated in Commercial and Institutional Building Construction at $2.2B and Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction at $10.6M. Southwest Valley Constructors current-year totals are partial, fiscal year to date, and the note clarifies that figures are contract obligations except for award-value figures in specific tables.

sections.heading: How concentrated are FY2026 obligations?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security accounts for the bulk of FY2026 obligations at $2.2B. The Department of Defense accounts for additional FY2026 obligations at $10.6M. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounts for $2.2B of the companys FY2026 market activity. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounts for $10.6M of the companys FY2026 market activity.
